What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials or workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item:
Warmers purchased before March 20, 2026: one year from purchase.
Warmers purchased on or after March 20, 2026: six months from purchase. You can register the warmer within 60 days of purchase for a free two-year limited warranty.
Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.
Silicone dishes: six months from purchase.
During the initial warranty period, defective products or parts are replaced at no charge. The extended limited warranty provides a 50% discount on replacements for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, misuse, incorrect voltage, attempted repairs, and loss or theft aren’t covered.
